raw_segments.text: Did, and Tito, you know, I helped you in prosecuting or persecuting your tutor way-faced Mr. Vining,
the parson in the pip, as we used to call him. He and Miss Wilson took the liberty of
falling in love with each other, at least Tito and I thought so. We surprised sundry
tender glances and sighs which we interpreted as tokens of La Belle passion, and I promise
you the public soon had the benefit of our discovery. We employed it as a sort of lever
to hoist our dead weights from the house.
Dear Mama, there, as soon as she got an inkling of the business, found out that it was of
an immoral tendency. Did you not, my lady mother?
